title: Above ground.

blocks.html:
Tanks located above ground, inside or outside of buildings, shall comply with any one of the following
design standards, as appropriate for the specific installation as determined by the engineer:
1. UL 80; such tanks shall be listed and labeled;
2. UL 142; such tanks shall be listed and labeled;
3. ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section VIII, Division 1 or 2; such tanks shall be labeled; or
4. Alternate tank design and construction standards contained in Section 1305.14.
